hero.caption: Edible seaweed farming on the small island of Nusa Lembongan, southeast of Bali, in Indonesia. The seaweed is growing on a rope. The bay on the coast is marked out by wooden posts into rectangular plots that are owned by different families. A boat is seen in some of the plots.
hero.alt: Edible seaweed farming on the small island of Nusa Lembongan, southeast of Bali, in Indonesia. The seaweed is growing on a rope. The bay on the coast is marked out by wooden posts into rectangular plots that are owned by different families. A boat is seen in some of the plots.
